reason: The frozen handoff wording can be misread as saying the complete live CNF after each prefix is only R_q. That is false because unused future compact-support source clauses remain live. The intended and mathematically valid induction object is the exact main-cascade factor R_q inside an explicitly preserved full-stage scaffold.

hardened_induction_scope.R_q: exact main-cascade factor AND_{i,j1..jq}(a_i OR t1_j1 OR ... OR t(q-1)_j(q-1) OR bq_jq)
hardened_induction_scope.READY_q_for_q_lt_h: R_q AND M^(q) AND FUTURE_SEEDS_(q+1..h-1), where M^(q)=AND_j,k(-bq_j OR tq_j OR b(q+1)_k) has already been derived by z_q
hardened_induction_scope.PRE_SUPPORT_q_for_q_ge_2: R_q AND U^(q) AND V^(q) AND FUTURE_SEEDS_(q+1..h-1), immediately before z_q
hardened_induction_scope.q1_order_note: z_1 is frozen before x,y, so the first ready b-layer state after x,y is R_1 AND M^(1) AND FUTURE_SEEDS_2..
hardened_induction_scope.step: EXISTS B^(q) READY_q IFF R_(q+1) AND FUTURE_SEEDS_(q+1..h-1)
hardened_induction_scope.then: if q+1<h, eliminate z_(q+1) to obtain READY_(q+1)
hardened_induction_scope.final: after eliminating B^(h-1), no support scaffold remains and the complete projected residual is exactly R_h

obligation_interpretation.INDUCTIVE_RESIDUAL_PASS: requires both exact R_q main-factor induction and exact full-stage scaffold accounting; support clauses may never be silently dropped
obligation_interpretation.DIRECT_GENERIC_PROJECTION_PASS: remains projection of the complete frozen source, including every support seed
